tasks.final_text: The National Museum of Galle (Galle National Museum) is one of the national museums of Sri lanka. It is located in the oldest remaining Dutch building in the Galle fort, Galle, a single storey colonnaded Dutch building built in 1656 as the commissariat store for the Dutch garrison at the fort.

Have you ever wondered what it might be like to stumble across the wastes of a world destroyed by hubris? Our story begins as very capable mages and scientists crash land on a post-apocalyptic world that is completely uninhabitable -- no air, no plants, no water, no food. The previuos inhabitants were so sure they could all ascend to godhood they destroyed their intire planet in pursuit of their foolish dreams.
